item.title: Romania shoots down third Russian drone in three days, summons ambassador
item.description: 🇷🇴 Romania shot down a third drone in as many days over the Black Sea and summoned Russia's ambassador over repeated airspace violations. The incidents raise fears of the Ukraine war spilling over into NATO territory, with Romania's president identifying at least one drone as a Russian Shahed model.

item.title: US pauses Iran attacks for second night as military advised Trump to halt bombing
item.description: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 The US has paused strikes on Iran for a second consecutive night after top military officials warned Trump that the campaign had reached the limits of its effectiveness and munitions stockpiles were dwindling. Iran also halted retaliatory attacks. Diplomatic talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue amid fears of energy supply disruption.

item.title: Israel launches military incursion into Syria as UN chief demands withdrawal
item.description: 🇮🇱🇸🇾 Israeli forces advanced into villages in southwestern Syria, setting up checkpoints and dropping leaflets warning residents, as UN Secretary-General Guterres visited Damascus and condemned violations of Syria's sovereignty. Guterres called for all sanctions on Syria to be lifted immediately.

item.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed by police during manhunt
item.description: 🇩🇪 German police shot and killed Abdul Ballout, the 21-year-old suspected of driving a van into a Berlin Pride crowd and stabbing people, killing one woman and injuring at least 29. Authorities called it a likely Islamist terror attack. Germany raised its threat level in response.

item.title: More than 360,000 evacuated as record wildfires ravage France and Spain
item.description: 🔥 Wildfires in southwestern France and Spain have forced over 360,000 people to flee their homes, with 55,000 evacuated overnight near Bordeaux alone. France has seen 42,000 hectares burned in one of its largest fires since WWII. Spain declared a national emergency as fires spread toward Madrid and Valencia.

item.title: Hezbollah says Iran will not sign final deal unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon
item.description: 🇱🇧🇮🇷 Hezbollah stated Iran has pledged not to sign a final nuclear deal with Washington unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon, as Iran's foreign minister called Israel's continued troop presence a breach of the US-Iran memorandum of understanding.

item.title: The Iran war permanently altered the global economy
item.description: 💰🌍 The global economic order has been reshaped by the US-Iran conflict, with shifts in oil markets, trade routes, and supply chains that are unlikely to simply revert to pre-war patterns even as a peace deal emerges.

item.title: Zelenskiy says G7 agreed Russia is not winning the war, discussed more sanctions
item.description: 🇺🇦🇷🇺 Ukrainian President Zelenskiy said G7 leaders agreed at the France summit that Russia is not winning its war in Ukraine and discussed additional sanctions to bring Moscow to negotiations.

item.title: Trump says Iran deal makes clear Tehran will never have a nuclear weapon
item.description: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 President Trump maintained the interim accord with Iran makes clear Tehran would never be allowed to develop a nuclear weapon, and suggested Syria could be better positioned to disarm Hezbollah.

item.title: EU lawmakers set to approve tougher migrant detention and deportation rules
item.description: 🇪🇺 European lawmakers are giving final approval to stricter migration rules that grant authorities broader powers to detain irregular arrivals and create expanded deportation facilities. The measures represent a significant hardening of EU migration policy amid rising anti-immigration sentiment across the bloc.

item.title: Israeli army prepares for prolonged Lebanon occupation despite US-Iran peace pact
item.description: 🇮🇱🇱🇧 Security sources report that Israeli troops remain ready to stay in occupied Lebanese territory if instructed by political leadership, even as the US-Iran peace deal moves toward signing. The stance contradicts Iranian FM Araghchi's demand for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon as part of any agreement.

item.title: UN chief Guterres visits Haiti as gang violence deepens humanitarian crisis
item.description: 🇭🇹 UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres visited Haiti as gang violence continues to worsen the country's humanitarian crisis, with thousands displaced and basic services collapsing. The visit highlights international concern over the Caribbean nation's descent into chaos.

item.title: Singapore May exports surge 38% driven by AI-related demand
item.description: 🇸🇬 Singapore's non-oil domestic exports jumped 38.4% year-on-year in May, fueled by robust AI-related shipments. The surge signals sustained Asian tech supply chain momentum even amid global trade uncertainties from US tariff policies and geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Israeli minister announces military takeover of Hebron administration
item.description: 🇮🇱 Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich says Israel has transferred authority over Hebron to the army, a significant escalation in West Bank control that could further complicate regional peace efforts.

item.title: Brazilian court convicts Eduardo Bolsonaro for seeking US interference in domestic affairs
item.description: 🇧🇷 A Brazilian court found Eduardo Bolsonaro guilty of attempting to enlist US government interference in Brazil, a case tied to broader tensions between Brasilia and Washington over tariffs and judicial sanctions.

item.title: Damaged Kyiv monastery from Russian strike will take two years to restore
item.description: 🇺🇦 Ukrainian officials say the nearly 1,000-year-old monastery in Kyiv, damaged by what Ukraine described as a deliberate Russian strike, requires around two years of restoration work.

item.title: Anti-capitalist protesters descend on G7 summit in France
item.description: 🇫🇷 Anti-capitalist demonstrations unfolded at the G7 summit in Evian-les-Bains as world leaders discussed global security, the Iran deal, and economic policy inside the heavily secured venue.

item.title: G7 leaders discuss granting trusted partners access to cutting-edge US AI models
item.description: 🤖 G7 leaders discussed a plan to grant select trusted partners access to advanced AI models from US firms such as Anthropic, three diplomatic sources said, potentially opening a path around restrictions on non-American use of the technology.

item.title: Israeli drone strikes kill at least 4 in southern Lebanon
item.description: 🇱🇧 Israeli drone strikes targeted three vehicles in southern Lebanon, killing at least four people and wounding others, Lebanons National News Agency reported. The strikes come amid ongoing tensions even as the US-Iran peace deal raises hopes for regional de-escalation.

item.title: Trump-backed candidate loses Georgia governor runoff in upset
item.description: 🇺🇸 Georgia Republican voters rejected President Trumps preferred nominee for the competitive open governor race, delivering a rare primary endorsement defeat. Rep. Mike Collins won the Republican Senate runoff and will face Sen. Jon Ossoff in a closely watched matchup.

item.title: White House talking points on Iran deal dont match reality, AP analysis finds
item.description: 🏛️ The White House proclaimed major victories in its Iran talking points, including Iran agreeing to never have a nuclear weapon and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. But the AP found several claims go against realities on the ground, especially regarding what Israel has agreed to in Lebanon. The MOU remains a closely guarded secret even among Republican allies.

item.title: Lebanon prepares new round of talks with Israel as president and PM coordinate strategy
item.description: 🇱🇧 Lebanese leaders discussed preparations for a new round of negotiations with Israel next week, as the US-Iran deal raises prospects for broader regional de-escalation and Israel-Hezbollah tensions ease.

item.title: Trump to host Iraqi Prime Minister at White House in mid-July
item.description: 🇮🇶 US President Trump will host Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi at the White House next month, as Washington reshapes Middle East alliances following the Iran peace deal.

item.title: Canada Carney raises China EV tariffs with Trump at G7, announces new Russia sanctions
item.description: 🇨🇦 Canadian PM Mark Carney held a short but intense discussion with Trump on China EV trade at the G7 summit, while also announcing fresh sanctions against Russia over the Ukraine war.

item.title: US holds off blacklisting China's DeepSeek and 100+ flagged firms to avoid escalating Beijing tensions
item.description: 🇨🇳 The Trump administration has delayed adding DeepSeek, CXMT, and over 100 Chinese companies flagged as national security risks to the trade blacklist, seeking to avoid further escalation with Beijing amid fragile diplomatic ties.
